resources.string: Connect your own authorized IPTV source and bring live TV into focus.
RAPOPLAYER is a player. It provides no channels, subscriptions, or content.
HTTP sends connection details and media without encryption. Prefer HTTPS when your provider supports it.
Editing. Done or Back returns to navigation.
Enter an http:// or https:// address without embedded credentials or fragments. Xtream server addresses must not include query parameters.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// guide URL, or leave this optional field blank.
Enter the username supplied by your provider.
Enter the password supplied by your provider.
Choose a channel to start watching
Try another category, clear your search, or refresh your source.
Guide unavailable. Playback is still available.
Connection details are stored encrypted on this device.
Remove the recent channel list from this device?
Remove cached programme information and channel-logo images. Your source, catalogue, favorites, and restrictions are kept.
Remove this source, its encrypted credentials, channels, favorites, history, guide, and source restrictions? The household PIN remains enabled.
A local household control for this device. It does not protect a compromised device. Forgotten PINs require clearing all app data in Android settings; this also removes sources and credentials.
Please enter your PIN again to change restrictions.
Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 Solid icons by Fonticons, Inc. — CC BY 4.0. Converted to Android vectors with centered viewports.
Playback targets: HTTP/HTTPS HLS and MPEG-TS, H.264 video and AAC audio. Prefer HTTPS. Device and provider compatibility require testing. No recording, catch-up, or persistent timeshift.
Playback paused. The provider’s live window may move.
Playback stopped while the app was away.
Some stream tracks are unsupported on this TV.
OK shows controls · Back closes controls · Up/Down changes channel
Use an http:// or https:// URL without embedded user credentials or fragments. For Xtream, use a server address without query parameters and enter the username and password separately.
Cannot reach the source. Check the TV’s network connection and source address.
The source took too long to respond. Try again.
A secure connection could not be established. Check the TV’s date and the provider’s certificate.
Authentication was rejected. Check your connection details.
The provider reports that this account is unavailable. Check your account with your provider.
The provider denied this request (403). This response alone does not explain why. Check access with your provider.
The source returned an unsuccessful response. Wait and try again.
No supported live channels were found. Check your source or choose another playlist.
The source returned an invalid catalogue. Check its address and format.
The source exceeds this release’s safe import limits. Use a smaller live catalogue or guide.
This stream or response format is unsupported. Try another channel or check the provider’s stream format.
The TV could not decode this stream. Try another channel or a compatible format.
The provider reports a connection limit. Stop other sessions and retry.
Guide information is unavailable. You can still watch channels.
The operation could not finish. Retry or edit your source. If encrypted data cannot be read, reset the app using Android settings.
